ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ZamElem_InsertUpdatePunkty' AND xtype = 'TR' ) DROP TRIGGER CDN.ZamElem_InsertUpdatePunkty;

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[ZamElem_InsertUpdatePunkty] ON [CDN].[ZamElem] FOR INSERT , UPDATE AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF UPDATE (ZaE_Punkty) IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM CDN.PunktyKonfig WHERE DATEDIFF(d, '18001228', GETDATE()) BETWEEN PuK_OkresOd AND PuK_OkresDo ) BEGIN UPDATE CDN.KntKarty SET Knt_PunktyOdebr = Knt_PunktyOdebr + iPunkty - dPunkty FROM CDN.KntKarty INNER JOIN ( SELECT ZaN_KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp , SUM(i.ZaE_Punkty) iPunkty , SUM(isnull(d.ZaE_Punkty, 0)) dPunkty FROM inserted i LEFT JOIN deleted d ON d.ZaE_GIDNumer = i.ZaE_GIDNumer AND d.ZaE_GIDLp = i.ZaE_GIDLp INNER JOIN CDN.ZamNag ON i.ZaE_GIDNumer = ZaN_GIDNumer GROUP BY ZaN_KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp ) Suma ON Knt_GIDNumer = ZaN_KntNumer AND ZaN_KntTyp = 32 END
SET NOCOUNT OFF
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ZamElem_DeletePunkty' AND xtype = 'TR' ) DROP TRIGGER CDN.ZamElem_DeletePunkty;

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[ZamElem_DeletePunkty] ON [CDN].[ZamElem] FOR DELETE AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM CDN.PunktyKonfig WHERE DATEDIFF(d, '18001228', GETDATE()) BETWEEN PuK_OkresOd AND PuK_OkresDo ) BEGIN
UPDATE ZaEO SET ZAEO.ZaE_Punkty = ZAEO.ZaE_Punkty + ROUND(ZaEK.ZaE_Ilosc * (select TOP 1 PuK_NagrodaPunkty from cdn.PunktyKonfig where PuK_Nagroda = 1 and PuK_ObiTyp = ZaEO.ZaE_TwrTyp and PuK_ObiNumer = ZaEO.ZaE_TwrNumer and PuK_OkresOd <= ZaN_DataWystawienia and PuK_OkresDo >= ZaN_DataWystawienia order by PuK_DataModyfikacji desc ),2) FROM deleted ZaEK INNER JOIN CDN.ZamZamLinki ON ZZL_ZSGidNumer = ZaEK.ZaE_GIDNumer AND ZZL_ZSGidLp = ZaEK.ZaE_GIDLp AND ZZL_ZSGidTyp = ZAEK.ZaE_GIDTyp AND ZZL_Kierunek = 32 INNER JOIN CDN.ZamElem ZaEO ON ZZL_ZZGidNumer = ZaEO.ZaE_GIDNumer AND ZZL_ZZGidLp = ZaEO.ZaE_GIDLp AND ZZL_ZZGidTyp = ZAEO.ZaE_GIDTyp INNER JOIN CDN.ZamNag ON ZAEO.ZaE_GIDNumer = ZaN_GIDNumer where ZaEK.ZaE_Nagroda > 0
UPDATE CDN.KntKarty SET Knt_PunktyOdebr = Knt_PunktyOdebr - dPunkty FROM CDN.KntKarty INNER JOIN ( SELECT ZaN_KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp , SUM(d.ZaE_Punkty) dPunkty FROM deleted d INNER JOIN CDN.ZamNag ON d.ZaE_GIDNumer = ZaN_GIDNumer WHERE d.ZaE_Punkty <> 0 AND ZaN_Stan & 32 <> 32 --anulowane GROUP BY ZaN_KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp ) Suma ON Knt_GIDNumer = ZaN_KntNumer AND ZaN_KntTyp = 32
END
SET NOCOUNT OFF
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ZamNag_UpdatePunkty' AND xtype = 'TR' ) DROP TRIGGER CDN.ZamNag_UpdatePunkty;

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[ZamNag_UpdatePunkty] ON [CDN].[ZamNag] FOR UPDATE AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF UPDATE (ZaN_KntNumer) OR UPDATE (ZaN_KntTyp) -- zmiana kontrahenta, nowemu trzeba odjąć, staremu dodać IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM CDN.PunktyKonfig WHERE DATEDIFF(d, '18001228', GETDATE()) BETWEEN PuK_OkresOd AND PuK_OkresDo ) BEGIN UPDATE CDN.KntKarty SET Knt_PunktyOdebr = Knt_PunktyOdebr + Suma FROM CDN.KntKarty INNER JOIN ( SELECT KntNumer , KntTyp , SUM(Ptk) Suma FROM ( SELECT isnull(SUM(ie.ZaE_Punkty), 0) Ptk , ZaN_KntNumer KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp KntTyp FROM inserted i INNER JOIN cdn.ZamElem ie ON ie.ZaE_GIDNumer = i.ZaN_GIDNumer GROUP BY i.ZaN_KntNumer , i.ZaN_KntTyp
UNION ALL
SELECT - isnull(SUM(de.ZaE_Punkty), 0) Ptk , ZaN_KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp FROM deleted d INNER JOIN cdn.ZamElem de ON de.ZaE_GIDNumer = d.ZaN_GIDNumer GROUP BY d.ZaN_KntNumer , d.ZaN_KntTyp ) a GROUP BY KntNumer , KntTyp ) b ON Knt_GIDNumer = b.KntNumer AND b.KntTyp = 32 END
IF UPDATE (ZaN_Stan) IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM CDN.PunktyKonfig WHERE DATEDIFF(d, '18001228', GETDATE()) BETWEEN PuK_OkresOd AND PuK_OkresDo ) BEGIN UPDATE CDN.KntKarty SET Knt_PunktyOdebr = Knt_PunktyOdebr - Ptk FROM CDN.KntKarty INNER JOIN ( SELECT isnull(SUM(ie.ZaE_Punkty), 0) Ptk , ZaN_KntNumer KntNumer , ZaN_KntTyp KntTyp FROM inserted i INNER JOIN cdn.ZamElem ie ON ie.ZaE_GIDNumer = i.ZaN_GIDNumer WHERE ZaN_Stan & 32 = 32 --anulowanie GROUP BY i.ZaN_KntNumer , i.ZaN_KntTyp ) b ON Knt_GIDNumer = b.KntNumer AND b.KntTyp = 32 END
SET NOCOUNT OFF
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'KntKarty_InsertUpdatePunkty' AND xtype = 'TR' ) DROP TRIGGER CDN.KntKarty_InsertUpdatePunkty;

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[KntKarty_InsertUpdatePunkty] ON [CDN].[KntKarty] FOR INSERT , UPDATE AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF UPDATE (Knt_Punkty) OR UPDATE (Knt_PunktyNalicz) OR UPDATE (Knt_PunktyOdebr) OR UPDATE (Knt_PunktyKorekta) IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM CDN.PunktyKonfig WHERE DATEDIFF(d, '18001228', GETDATE()) BETWEEN PuK_OkresOd AND PuK_OkresDo ) BEGIN UPDATE a SET a.Knt_Punkty = CASE WHEN i.Knt_PunktyNalicz + i.Knt_PunktyOdebr + i.Knt_PunktyKorekta < 0 THEN 0 ELSE i.Knt_PunktyNalicz + i.Knt_PunktyOdebr + i.Knt_PunktyKorekta END FROM CDN.KntKarty a INNER JOIN inserted i ON a.Knt_GIDNumer = i.Knt_GIDNumer LEFT JOIN deleted d ON d.Knt_GIDNumer = i.Knt_GIDNumer WHERE isnull(d.Knt_Punkty,0) <> i.Knt_Punkty OR isnull(d.Knt_PunktyNalicz,0) <> i.Knt_PunktyNalicz OR isnull(d.Knt_PunktyOdebr,0) <> i.Knt_PunktyOdebr OR isnull(d.Knt_PunktyKorekta,0) <> i.Knt_PunktyKorekta END
SET NOCOUNT OFF
